skills.skill: Round a whole number to the nearest ten, hundred, or thousand

misconceptions.pattern: Truncates to the place instead of rounding — drops the lower digits rather than checking whether to round up (e.g. 1489 to the nearest hundred answered 1400 instead of 1500).

strategies.intent: Look only at the digit just below the rounding place: 5 or more rounds up, less than 5 rounds down; then set every lower digit to zero.
